description: Rotten-egg smell from the boiler when it fires up (reported by WhatsApp 22:40 Fri 09/10). 82-year-old visitor in the flat.

history.note: Safety advice sent to tenant by WhatsApp (leave, no switches or flames, 0800 111 999). Delivered and read.
Tenant confirmed everyone out and she has called 0800 111 999. Job raised as EMERGENCY.

National Gas Emergency Service (Cadent) attended. Leak found at the boiler gas valve. Supply capped at the boiler, appliance labelled 'At Risk', meter left on for the hob. Occupants allowed back in. Engineer advises a Gas Safe engineer to repair before the boiler is used.
HeatRight Ltd (C-11, Gas Safe 550123) assigned. Visit confirmed for Sat 10/10 at 10:00. Within landlord limit for attendance and diagnosis.
Landlord Ben Hartley informed by email: gas service attended, boiler capped, HeatRight booked 10:00 Saturday, quote to follow before any repair over £300.
HeatRight dropped off 2 oil-filled electric heaters for the night (no charge). Tenant confirmed received.
